summary: Studio major-feature regression executed on public URL with real model calls. Backend Studio security/authorization tests passed (10/10). Desktop Studio flow passed end-to-end including consent gating, wrong-passphrase rejection, with-memory vs without-memory independence, encrypted save flow, and lock/unlock state clearing. Mobile consent layout verification remained partially incomplete due flaky mobile navigation/tap behavior during automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent tap/click flakiness on 'Create vault & explore demo' during automation; button sometimes did not submit, while Enter key fallback succeeded.
Automated click on Studio nav intermittently failed with out-of-viewport behavior while sidebar open, reducing reliability of mobile Studio e2e checks.

integration_issues.issue: Could not consistently complete full mobile consent-flow assertions in automation because of mobile tap/navigation instability before reaching review stage in all runs.

action_items: Main agent should manually verify mobile (390px) Studio consent dialog internal scrolling and CTA visibility in-browser due automation instability.
Harden mobile AuthDialog submit interaction (tap handler reliability/loading state) to avoid intermittent non-submit behavior.
Harden mobile sidebar Studio navigation interaction to avoid out-of-viewport click failures.
Add deterministic mobile e2e test hooks for opening Studio directly (e.g., stable deep-link route or visible CTA).
critical_code_review_comments: test_credentials file is effectively empty (/app/memory/test_credentials.md). Per playbook, credentials context is missing and should be maintained for future auth-related testing continuity.

Studio budget guard increments counters before limit check; once limit is exceeded, repeated denied attempts still continue incrementing counts. Consider whether this accounting behavior is intended for user experience and monitoring semantics.
Mobile e2e reliability risk: key flows depend on small interactive controls inside overlays/sidebar; add explicit test-stable hooks for mobile transitions.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated demo users via Explore Demo and /api/auth/demo during tests; no persistent seed script added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop public-url Studio test passed with real GPT-5.4 Mini runs (2 paid calls used: with-memory + without-memory). Verified: consent not prechecked, approve disabled until consent, wrong passphrase rejection, recipient/privacy disclosure text, private memory disabled in picker, save-result posts encrypted_payload only, lock/unlock clears in-memory result. Backend studio security regression file added and passing (10/10). Remaining gap: robust mobile consent-flow automation due intermittent mobile submit/nav interaction failures.
rca of the issue: Mobile instability appears interaction-layer related rather than backend: reproduction in automation at 390px showed intermittent non-submit on [data-testid='vault-submit'] and sidebar Studio nav click issues (out-of-viewport/intercepted). Fallback using Enter key on confirm field succeeded, indicating event/click handling fragility under mobile layout/overlay conditions.
